description: Ways the ROSI 4 to ROSI 5 bridge can fail. Written before the bridge code. 'unit' ids must appear in a test name in src/tests/v5Bridge.test.ts; 'e2e' ids must be covered by a scenario in the bridge E2E evidence.

sig-wrong-key.text: A file signed by a different key is accepted.

sig-tampered-file.text: A modified or truncated file is accepted.

sig-tampered-comment.text: An edited trusted comment (global signature) is accepted.

sig-legacy-unhashed.text: A legacy 'Ed' (not prehashed) signature is accepted; Tauri only produces 'ED'.

sig-malformed.text: Garbage, truncated, or oversized signatures or keys crash instead of being rejected.

sig-keyid-mismatch.text: A signature whose key id differs from the trusted key is checked anyway.

manifest-not-v5.text: A 4.x, 6.x-shaped, or invalid version is offered as ROSI 5.

manifest-prerelease-on-stable.text: A stable-channel user is offered a ROSI 5 beta.

manifest-wrong-platform.text: The wrong OS or architecture artifact is chosen.

manifest-foreign-host.text: A download URL outside the ROSI release path (other host, other repo, http, credentials) is used.

manifest-missing-fields.text: A manifest without a URL or signature for this platform is offered.

platform-emulated-x64.text: An x64 ROSI 4 on an ARM64 PC or Mac installs x64 ROSI 5 instead of native ARM64.

platform-old-windows.text: Windows older than build 19041 is offered ROSI 5.

platform-old-macos.text: macOS older than 26 is offered ROSI 5.

platform-linux.text: Linux is offered an automatic install, or Linux ARM64 is offered a build that does not exist.

platform-msstore.text: The Microsoft Store build tries to bridge instead of leaving updates to the Store.

bad-download-rejected.text: A download that fails the signature check is installed, or ROSI 4 is changed.

v4-killed-before-flush.text: ROSI 5's installer kills ROSI 4 before it saves settings and the queue.

install-fails-v4-removed.text: ROSI 4 is uninstalled although ROSI 5 did not install.

shortcuts-lost.text: Removing ROSI 4 deletes ROSI 5's Start menu or desktop shortcuts.

v4-left-behind.text: ROSI 4's program files or uninstall entry remain after a successful bridge.

data-not-imported.text: ROSI 5 starts without the user's ROSI 4 settings.

v4-data-deleted.text: ROSI 4's data folder is deleted, so going back to ROSI 4 loses settings.

failure-silent.text: A failed bridge leaves the user with no app running and no explanation.

no-consent.text: The bridge downloads or installs without the user choosing to upgrade.
